rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides comprehensive market intelligence across stocks, cryptocurrencies, forex, and economic indicators. Includes 54 tools spanning stock scanning with custom filters, technical indicators (RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands), options chains with Greeks, SEC insider trading data from Form 4 filings, earnings calendars, analyst ratings, and crypto sentiment indices. Eight modules work without API keys using TradingView, SEC EDGAR, CoinGecko, and CBOE data sources.
